task_completion.description: Open the 'Mitosis' sample hyperstack in ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An ImageJ window titled 'mitosis.tif' or 'Mitosis' showing a multi-frame cell image.

task_completion.description: Create a Max Intensity Z-Projection to flatten the hyperstack into a 2D time-lapse.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new ImageJ window titled 'MAX_mitosis.tif' or similar, indicating a Z-projection was performed.

task_completion.description: Locate the cell near (145, 130) at Frame 1.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor or a selection tool is positioned over the central cell at Frame 1; coordinates in the ImageJ status bar should be near (145, 130).

task_completion.description: Perform manual tracking across frames 1, 6, 11, 16, and 21.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent advancing the frame slider and clicking on the cell or recording coordinates at the specified frame intervals.

task_completion.description: Identify and record the right-most daughter cell at Frame 21.
task_completion.visual_evidence: At Frame 21, the selection or cursor is on the daughter cell further to the right (higher X value) compared to the other daughter cell.

task_completion.description: Save the tracking results to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog or a terminal command showing the file being saved to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/tracking_trace.csv'.

integrity.description: The agent used the ImageJ GUI for image processing and tracking.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the ImageJ menu items being clicked (e.g., Image > Stacks > Z Project) rather than just script execution.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the ground truth coordinates without looking at the image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The cursor position in ImageJ matches the coordinates being recorded in the CSV or results table.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 'Mitosis' sample specifically.
integrity.visual_evidence: The image window being manipulated is the 'Mitosis' sample provided by ImageJ, not a placeholder.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Mitosis' sample is a standard ImageJ hyperstack. The target cell starts at approximately (145, 130). By Frame 21, the cell has divided; the right-most daughter cell is located at approximately (170, 130). The final CSV must contain 5 rows for frames 1, 6, 11, 16, and 21. Coordinates should be within 25 pixels of: F1:(145,130), F6:(146,130), F11:(145,130), F16:(155,130), F21:(170,130).
